## Prompt Title
A clear, descriptive title for your prompt.

## Category
Where should this prompt be placed? (e.g., development/javascript, devops/kubernetes)

## Description
A brief description of what this prompt helps accomplish and when to use it.

## Tags
List relevant tags for this prompt (e.g., `debugging`, `testing`, `code-review`)

## Compatible AI Tools
- [ ] ChatGPT (specify version if known)
- [ ] Claude (specify version if known)
- [ ] Other (please specify)

## Prompt Content
Paste your full prompt here, with placeholders in {curly_braces}

## Example Input
Provide an example of how someone would use this prompt with placeholders filled in

## Expected Output
Provide an example of the expected output or describe what should be expected

## Additional Notes
Any other information that might be helpful for users of this prompt.

## I confirm that:
- [ ] I've tested this prompt with at least one AI tool
- [ ] This prompt doesn't duplicate an existing prompt in the library
- [ ] This prompt follows the quality guidelines in CONTRIBUTING.md
